title: C7b build-ahead: `os migrate organization-ownership --apply` and E5's pure row→definition mappers in core (drafts from main; the --apply PR lands after #15204 stage 8)
body:
Part of #15211

**Handed out of the #15194 epic subtree to the `domain:engine` lane.** The epic PM (`session_01Rerax7QTjKMPCUZxQUtPFR`, `marchtian`) did this at the maintainer's request in its session on 2026-10-12: clear next-step work that can be built ahead goes to lane PMs, and the maintainer's tasks are high priority (`priority:p1`). This card is the lane's claim surface. #15211 stays open and blocked for its landing gate; this card carries no `Blocked-by:`, because building ahead is not landing.

## Why now
- #15211 is release-cut condition (b) of the final v18 release (6102862135). The `next` prerelease is exempt (maintainer ruling 6117174845).
- #15211's `Blocked-by: #15196` / `#15204` gate its landing. Building ahead follows the epic's rule: "Development runs ahead of landing" (6095755866).
- On `main` (`06cc45dc36`), `os migrate organization-ownership` already exists as a **read-only plan** (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/organization-ownership.ts`, `utils/organization-ownership-plan.ts`, `utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts`). The `--apply` half of #15211's scope is not built.

## Scope (read #15211's body in full first; it governs)
1. **E5's mappers, in core.** Seat answer 6110777865 (E5 → A), and its note on #15211, 6110790598.
   - Add pure functions beside `convertPositionBindingRows` (`packages/core/src/security/position-binding-conversion.ts:90`), each with pins:
     - a permission-set row → definition, the logic of `permissionSetBodyFromRow` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-set-projection.ts:409`);
     - a position row → definition, the mapping in `position-environment-backfill.ts`.
   - Use new files in core only. ⛔ **Do not edit `packages/plugins/plugin-security/**`.** Those files belong to #15204: stage 8 (`session_01MGoWgeE8rhsrig77V4oUZn`, building now) and 7a/7b, which will switch to these functions and delete their copies.
   - This PR changes no behaviour, and may land when green.
2. **`--apply`**, per #15211's scope:
   - the explicit backup acknowledgement;
   - the fate order attribution → verified id→name rewrite → mirror deletion → column drops;
   - idempotent, and resumable from a recorded checkpoint;
   - an operator ceremony, ⛔ never a boot step.
   - **The id→name rewrite:** `sys_user_permission_set.permission_set_id` → `permission_set`. The column stays until C7b (#15204 stage-8 refresh 6116546399, E3): stage 8 redeclares it as `Field.text`, keeping its stored ids, the unique index (`user_id`, `permission_set_id`, `organization_id`) and the `(permission_set_id)` index. C7b drops the column and both indexes, and judges whether the unique index still means anything once new grants write NULL there.
   - **Mirror deletion** stays behind fate 2's own gate: C2's rewrite report shows every reference resolves by name.
   - The inventory's `authored` categories convert through step 1's mappers (6110790598).
   - It absorbs #14570 and #15086, as #15211 says.
   - **This PR stays a draft until #15204's stage 8 is on `main`.** Then merge `main`, re-run, and land.
3. **#15211's acceptance:** a fixture database carrying every fate.

## Boundaries
- ⛔ No stacked PRs; every PR is based on `main`.
- ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/` or `CHANGELOG.md`.
- ⛔ Never edit plugin-security files or `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` here.
- **Coordination:** post on this card. Post one pointer on #15204 when a PR opens, so the epic seat can align stage 8 and 7a/7b with it. Questions go here, and the epic seat answers here.
- Re-verify on `main` before building that no branch or PR already does this (the maintainer's 「不要重复开发」).

## Refs
#15211 · ADR-0131 D10, D4 · seat answers 6110777865 and 6116546399 · seat note 6110790598 · release-cut record 6102862135 · ruling 6117174845.
